meta_cites_federal_law_008.answer: Basic equipment for school nurses shall include a computer with internet access and printer w/ paper (to access the District student information system and print out reports and immunization records) and a fireproof, locking file cabinet (to maintain medical records per HIPAA federal regulations). JROTC Instructors shall have an extended contract and salary as provided in federal regulations.
